meaning:
ἵλεως, -ων
(Att.. for ἵλαος), [in LXX for חָלִיל, 1Ki.14:45, 2Ki.20:20, al.; ἵ. εἶναι, סָלַח, 3Ki.8:30 ff. Jer.31:34, al. ;]
propitious, merciful: τ. ἀδικίαες, Heb.8:12 (Je, l.with; cf.1 Ki, l.with); ἵ. σοι (sc. ἔστω ὁ θεός), Mat.16:22 (cf. 1Sam, l.with).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
